followups.scope: B4 Windows HID factory, native admission, cancel, disposal and access
followups.outcome: One selected route, no transport fallback. Windows report open/Get/Set execute synchronously and ignore compatibility tokens. Keepalive-driven CANCEL drains the original response; inner adapter supplies no terminal wake. Session exchange drain differs from another thread's raw connection disposal, whose SafeHandle borrow may outlast registry release. Nested report staging remains independent of cleared adapter copies.
followups.remaining: Windows driver/ABI/access/runtime evidence and selected repairs remain open; no observed race or universal elevation rule.

followups.scope: B4 built-in CCID native owner and conditional PCI applicability
followups.outcome: CTAP APDUs reach the single-worker PCSC native owner, actual transmit, checked disconnect/context release and exact claim outcome. Managed PCI reaches the published shim without conversion. Conditional Linux LP64 pcsc-lite target has 16-byte PCI versus managed 8; Windows two-DWORD layout and macOS framework selection remain separate.
followups.remaining: Installed JIT/AOT producer/header/flags, string boundary and actual successful native transmit are unqualified. Source drain order supplies no physical unpower/app-state proof.

followups.scope: B6 CTAP APDU format, configuration, status and recovery
followups.outcome: INS10 wraps nonempty command-prefixed CTAP request with CLA80/P1P2 zero/Le zero. Both formatters append encoded Le. Initial SELECT/GetInfo precede options configuration; major-zero Configure ignores ForceShortApdus. Plain 61xx follow-ups use configured instruction and zero CLA/P1/P2/Le; no 6C resend. APDU errors/warnings precede CTAP status classification; first plain chained-fragment uncertainty can miss recovery latch.
followups.remaining: Chosen APDU/profile policy, exact ISO clauses, stronger recovery/copy guarantees and device interoperability remain open.

followups.scope: B6 SCP factory/rebind and post-handshake applet/authentication state
followups.outcome: FIDO SELECT/GetInfo and detected USB gate precede configure/SCP. CTAP rebinds backend without another SELECT and issues no post-handshake protected CTAP probe during creation. Helpers issue handshake commands but no additional SELECT. Historical IsAuthenticated flag after setup is separate from SD-side first correct-MAC a/c authentication and CTAP PIN/UV permissions.
followups.remaining: Actual FIDO selection survival, vendor operation/profile acceptance and final SCP11 1.4 clauses remain open. A plain SELECT after SCP is not an adopted recovery action.

followups.scope: B6 secure empty-command, counter, phase and response chaining applicability
followups.outcome: Ordinary CTAP data is nonempty; protected empty-data remaining C0 commands reach current empty encryption. Encrypt's counter mutation can precede stateAdvanced/failure notification. INS82 exemption is instruction-based; normal CTAP INS10/default C0 do not directly select it, while unvalidated custom remaining instruction can select that path without implying profile support. Secure receiver protects each follow-up and unmacs/decrypts each response before assembly; synthetic signed61xx/6A82 fake is not an independent conforming wire oracle.
followups.remaining: Independent split-block/RMAC/bare-error wire/profile evidence, provider failure handling, phase policy and physical interoperability remain open. No new exploit or test result.

followups.scope: B6 request/response/fragment/plaintext and setup failure owners
followups.outcome: Actual formatted output clears after transport await; stack/raw/fragment/failure-assembly/protected/decrypted-temporary owners remain separate. Core APDU error before return leaves backend responseData unassigned. Returned CTAP failure normally clears backend Data; success transfers before decode. Parameters share contained disposable owners; post-state-return setup guard differs from earlier SCP03 derivation failure window. Original X020 diagnostic-callback failure remains independent.
